text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The results last time could've been
better, but
this time will be different!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll repay all of the hard work
you've put
in, so be sure to watch me
run today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to put a huge smile on
your face.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'll be back in no time! Be sure to
greet me
with your sparkling smile! ♪
